answer: Use-it-or-lose-it reputation decay. Each identity accrues a delta of reputation only through verified bilateral trades, and that delta decays on a fixed schedule unless refreshed. Enforcement is per-identity: an attacker must sustain real trade volume across every clone to keep reputation above threshold, so cost scales linearly with clone count. A meadow of idle accounts withers to zero. Cheap quartz-grade hardware cannot fake sustained trade flow, making each sybil cost real inventory and counterparty risk.
